description: Consumer Affairs Authority  - Directive No. 60 made to direct all manufacturers, etc. that all the Conditions Issued in respect of goods shall be Printed in all 03 Languages w.e.f. 01.01.2017
reasoning: This gazette contains a direction issued by the Consumer Affairs Authority under the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 09 of 2003. It mandates a regulatory requirement (printing warranty conditions in three languages) for manufacturers, importers, and traders. This content fits the definition of a Legal/Regulatory Gazette as it involves regulatory frameworks, compliance requirements, and a statutory instrument issued under an existing Act.
